quest.title: Exchanging Pointers
quest.description: In order to learn the tricks of a professional mixologist, Diona decides to exchange pointers with Connor.

talks.objective: Go to Dawn Winery and meet Diona

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Alright, are you done mixing the drink?

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Oh, are you... done? I'm very, uh... excited to taste your new work.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: I wonder what kind of... surprise will be in store for us.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Connor, the most important thing right now is to show Diona our sincerity, understand?

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Great job, keep it up. We'll definitely be able to hire Diona as resident bartender here!

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: I hope it works. I was out there for weeks waiting for this chance... We mustn't let this opportunity go to waste.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: You really outdid yourself this time, Connor. As long as we can get Diona to come work here, all our hard work will have paid off. This is just the first step.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Now don't forget, Diona must feel our sincerity and our passion! Oh, and remember, try not to overdo it...

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: No problem. We've already gone over this many times before.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you guys talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Huh?! Oh, hehe... nothing. We're just uhh... just discussing some winery business matters, yeah... hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Y—Yeah, we're talking about business. Let's go over the recent upkeep costs of the winery again, shall we, Elzer?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Remember, do everything completely opposite to how Connor did. This is the only way we can reach my... I mean, our goal.
